start: A member's page, member has no running plan; the gym has plans

steps.action: Open 'Sell membership'
user_sees: A plan picker, 'Starts on', 'Plan price' ('Leave blank for the plan price. Type a lower number to give a discount.'), 'Joining fee' ('Charged once, on joining.'), 'Received now' ('Leave blank if they will pay later. It will show in Dues.'), 'Notes (optional)'
must_not: A plan of another gym
A joining fee charged to someone who already paid one

steps.action: Pick a plan, type what was received, pick how it was paid
user_sees: 'Reference (optional)' and 'Received on' show; the last day and the balance are worked out
must_not: A balance below zero

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the sheet closes and the plan shows on the member's page with its receipt
must_not: Two memberships or two receipts
A receipt with no name of who took the money
An amount that differs from what was typed

start: A member's page, a running plan

steps.action: Open 'Freeze / extra days'
user_sees: Reasons 'Freeze – Medical', 'Freeze – Travel', 'Freeze – Other', 'Gift – Extra days'; 'How many days'; 'Or type the days (1–365)'; 'New last day: —'
must_not: The sheet offered on a cancelled plan

steps.action: Pick 'Freeze – Travel', 10 days, tap 'Add days'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the last day is 10 days later and the plan's history has the reason
must_not: The days added twice
The fee or dues changed

start: A member's page, a plan that starts on a later day

steps.action: Tap 'Change start date'
user_sees: A sheet 'Change start date' with 'New start date' and 'Pick the day the member will start.'
must_not: The button on a plan that has already started

steps.action: Pick a day and tap 'Save start date'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the first and last day both move by the same days
must_not: The plan made shorter or longer
An overlap with the member's other plan saved

start: A member's page, a running plan

steps.action: Tap cancel on the plan
user_sees: A confirm sheet that asks for a reason, with 'Cancel membership'
must_not: The plan cancelled by one tap

steps.action: Type a reason and tap 'Cancel membership'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the plan shows as cancelled
must_not: The cancel saved twice
Receipts deleted

start: Sell membership and Freeze / extra days, with wrong input

steps.action: Open 'Sell membership' in a gym with no plans
user_sees: 'You haven’t created any plans yet. Add a plan first, then you can sell it here.'
must_not: An empty picker with a live 'Confirm'

steps.action: Type a price above the plan's price and tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: A question about the higher price; the button now says 'Yes, save'
must_not: Saved at the higher price without asking

steps.action: In Freeze / extra days type 0, then 400
user_sees: 'A whole number from 1 to 365.' and 'Add days' grey
must_not: Days outside 1 to 365 saved

steps.action: In Change start date pick a day that clashes
user_sees: The reason in words and 'Save start date' grey
must_not: A clash saved

start: A member's page, a plan just cancelled

steps.action: Tap the undo on the cancelled plan
user_sees: 'Cancel undone.' and the plan runs again with the same days
must_not: A second plan made
Days lost

steps.action: Open the sell sheet from a renew button
user_sees: The title 'Renew membership' with the start day after the old plan's last day
must_not: A gap or an overlap with the old plan by default

start: A member's page after a sale by a front-desk person

steps.action: Open the receipt
user_sees: The name of the person who took the money
must_not: A receipt with no taker
The owner's name on the desk's sale

steps.action: Open the plan's history
user_sees: Each freeze or extra-days change with its reason
must_not: A changed last day with no reason kept

start: A member's page as front desk, member has no running plan

steps.action: Open 'Sell membership'
user_sees: The same sheet, with 'Leave blank for the plan price. The front desk can give at most 10% off.'
must_not: The owner's discount hint

steps.action: Pick a plan, type what was received
user_sees: The last day and the balance
must_not: A discount box that takes more than 10% off without a word

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the plan and a receipt that names this front-desk person
must_not: Two receipts
A receipt in the owner's name

start: A member's page as front desk, a plan about to end

steps.action: Open the sell sheet from the renew button
user_sees: The title 'Renew membership'; the joining fee is not charged again ('Already paid a joining fee before, so it is not charged again.')
must_not: A second joining fee

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: A new plan that starts after the old one ends
must_not: The old plan changed

start: A member's page as front desk

steps.action: Look for 'Freeze / extra days', 'Change start date' and cancel on a plan
user_sees: None of the three buttons; a personal-training pack shows a plain note
must_not: Any of the three sheets opening for the front desk
A way to undo a cancel

steps.action: In Sell membership type a price more than 10% below the plan, or a lower joining fee, and tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: A refusal in words under that box; nothing saved
must_not: The sale saved at the lower price

steps.action: Set 'Received on' more than 31 days back, or ahead of today
user_sees: A refusal in words under the date
must_not: A receipt dated outside what the front desk may use

steps.action: Open 'Sell membership' in a gym with no plans
user_sees: 'There are no plans to sell yet. Ask the owner to add a plan.'
must_not: A link to the owner's plan editor

start: A member's page as front desk, a plan sold a minute ago by mistake

steps.action: Look for a way to take it back
user_sees: No cancel and no void for the front desk; the plan stays until the owner acts
must_not: The front desk cancelling the plan or the receipt
The plan silently removed

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm' and watch the button
user_sees: 'Saving…' and the button grey until it is saved
must_not: A second save from a second tap

start: A member's page as front desk after a sale

steps.action: Open the receipt, then Money
user_sees: The receipt with this person's name; in Money only dues, never collections totals
must_not: A money total for the gym
Another staff member's takings added up
